notes.title: Subterraneus is now better than ever!
notes.content:
Subterraneus is now Better than Ever!
The 1.1 update is officialy live!

So, what's new?
- [b]New price[/b]: 8$!
- [b]Extended help system[/b] to provide full help with multiple levels of hints! You won't be blocked anymore! At least, I hope so!
- [b]Steam achievements[/b]! Go get them! Who will be the first to get the 100%? Well, me off course! But beside me ? Who will it be? Maybe YOU!
- [b]Enhanced graphics[/b]! Because it's always better when it's better. (Yes, I know, it's deep philosophy)
- In-game collectibles! An occasion to learn more about Subterraneus characters in a very briefly way!
- [b]New gameplay options[/b]! Is there to many interest points for you ? There is an option! You have a highly disruptive environment and you don't want to miss a single word of dialogues? There is an option! (and thank you, it's means a lot to me!) You want to win at the lottery? Well, there is no option for that... But I wish you the best!
- [b]bugfixes[/b]! All of the bugs I could find have been fixed!
- brand new bugs! Hopefully not, but If you encounter any of them, please tell me!

If you [b]want to help me[/b], then you can play the game, [b]leave a review[/b] on Steam [b]or tell your friends[/b] about Subterraneus!
Any help for spreading the word is very appreciated! 😄

Thank you all!
